## Description {#details}

A C++ testing framework must be able to check if an expression (usually a function call), throws or not an exception.


<SectionUser title="Examples">

</SectionUser>


<ProgramListing extension="cpp">

<CodeLine><Highlight kind="normal">mt::expect (mt::throws ([] &#123; exercise&#95;throw (</Highlight><Highlight kind="keyword">true</Highlight><Highlight kind="normal">); &#125;)) &lt;&lt; </Highlight><Highlight kind="stringliteral">&quot;exception thrown&quot;</Highlight><Highlight kind="normal">;</Highlight></CodeLine>
<CodeLine><Highlight kind="normal"></Highlight></CodeLine>
<CodeLine><Highlight kind="normal">mt::expect (mt::throws&lt;std::runtime&#95;error&gt; ([] &#123; </Highlight><Highlight kind="keywordflow">throw</Highlight><Highlight kind="normal"> std::runtime&#95;error&#123; </Highlight><Highlight kind="stringliteral">&quot;&quot;</Highlight><Highlight kind="normal"> &#125;; &#125;))</Highlight></CodeLine>
<CodeLine><Highlight kind="normal">        &lt;&lt; </Highlight><Highlight kind="stringliteral">&quot;std::runtime&#95;error thrown&quot;</Highlight><Highlight kind="normal">;</Highlight></CodeLine>
<CodeLine><Highlight kind="normal"></Highlight></CodeLine>
<CodeLine><Highlight kind="normal">mt::expect (mt::nothrow ([] &#123; exercise&#95;throw (</Highlight><Highlight kind="keyword">false</Highlight><Highlight kind="normal">); &#125;)) &lt;&lt; </Highlight><Highlight kind="stringliteral">&quot;exception not thrown&quot;</Highlight><Highlight kind="normal">;</Highlight></CodeLine>

</ProgramListing>

If a more elaborate logic is required, for example for expecting multiple exceptions, use an explicit <code>try</code> with multiple <code>catch</code> statements and report the results with <code>expect(true)</code> or <code>expect(false)</code>.


<ProgramListing extension="cpp">

<CodeLine><Highlight kind="keywordflow">try</Highlight><Highlight kind="normal"></Highlight></CodeLine>
<CodeLine><Highlight kind="normal">  &#123;</Highlight></CodeLine>
<CodeLine><Highlight kind="normal">    compute&#95;answer ();</Highlight></CodeLine>
<CodeLine><Highlight kind="normal">  &#125;</Highlight></CodeLine>

<CodeLine><Highlight kind="normal">  &#123;</Highlight></CodeLine>

<CodeLine><Highlight kind="normal">  &#125;</Highlight></CodeLine>
